category_title: Students with limited expressive language who use visual supports and exhibit avoidance behaviors
minimal_context: Evan is expected to participate in a 30-minute whole-group calendar activity using a SmartBoard to review the date, days of the week, and weather.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our whole-group calendar activity. Let's look at the SmartBoard to review the date, days of the week, and the weather.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands still and does not follow the direction to join the group activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Evan, you need to come over here and participate with the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Protests the activity by turning and running away from the calendar area.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop running and come back to the SmartBoard.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues running and elopes into the unoccupied adjacent classroom to avoid the group activity.)

dialogue_combined:

STUDENT: (Continues running and elopes into the unoccupied adjacent classroom to avoid the group activity.)
